uncited: **Server: Ray Marching and Depth Estimation.** Render the volume using a ray marcher.
**Server: Compact Buffer.** Move all samples with a radius of zero to one side of the buffer.
**Client: Build BVH.** Reinterpret the received object-space samples as semi-transparent spheres.
**Client: Ray Trace.** Render the point cloud using first-hit ray tracing.
